```{r}
# ── Step 1: Fit baseline GPP ~ VPD model per site ────────────────────────────
baseline_models <- bind_rows(sites_daily) %>%
  drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  group_map(~ lm(GPP ~ VPD, data = .x), .keep = TRUE) %>%
  setNames(unique(bind_rows(sites_daily)$site))

# ── Step 2: Define VPD perturbation scenarios from CMIP6 ─────────────────────
vpd_scenarios <- tibble(
  scenario   = c("Current", "SSP2-4.5 2050", "SSP5-8.5 2050", "SSP5-8.5 2100"),
  vpd_delta  = c(0, 0.15, 0.25, 0.45)   # kPa increase above current
)

# ── Step 3: Predict GPP under each scenario per site ─────────────────────────
site_data <- bind_rows(sites_daily) %>%
  drop_na(VPD, GPP)

sensitivity_results <- site_data %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_VPD = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_GPP = mean(GPP, na.rm = TRUE),
    vpd_slope = coef(lm(GPP ~ VPD))[2],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  crossing(vpd_scenarios) %>%           # expand for each scenario
  mutate(
    VPD_new      = mean_VPD + vpd_delta,
    GPP_predicted = mean_GPP + vpd_slope * vpd_delta,  # linear perturbation
    GPP_change    = GPP_predicted - mean_GPP,
    GPP_pct_change = (GPP_change / mean_GPP) * 100
  )

# ── Step 4: Plot — which sites lose most GPP? ─────────────────────────────────
sensitivity_results %>%
  filter(scenario != "Current") %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = GPP_pct_change, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "SSP2-4.5 2050" = "#4682B4",
    "SSP5-8.5 2050" = "#F28C28",
    "SSP5-8.5 2100" = "#c0392b"
  )) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% change in GPP", fill = NULL,
       title = "Projected GPP response to rising VPD",
       subtitle = "Based on observed GPP~VPD sensitivity and CMIP6 projections") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")

# ── Step 5: Vulnerability ranking ────────────────────────────────────────────
# Which sites are most vulnerable under worst case scenario?
sensitivity_results %>%
  filter(scenario == "SSP5-8.5 2100") %>%
  arrange(GPP_pct_change) %>%
  select(site, mean_VPD, vpd_slope, GPP_pct_change)
```
```{r}
sensitivity_results %>%
  filter(scenario == "SSP5-8.5 2100") %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = GPP_pct_change, colour = GPP_pct_change > 0)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = site, y = 0, yend = GPP_pct_change), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#4682B4", "FALSE" = "#c0392b"),
                      guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% change in GPP",
       title = "Projected GPP change under SSP5-8.5 2100") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
```{r}
sensitivity_results %>%
  filter(scenario == "SSP5-8.5 2100") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vpd_slope, y = GPP_pct_change, label = site)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "#4682B4") +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.8, size = 3, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "#F28C28", 
              linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "GPP ~ VPD slope (baseline sensitivity)",
       y = "% change in GPP (SSP5-8.5 2100)",
       title = "Sites with stronger VPD sensitivity are more vulnerable") +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
# ── Join cluster info onto sensitivity results ────────────────────────────────
sensitivity_clustered <- sensitivity_results %>%
  left_join(site_slopes %>% select(site, cluster_multi), by = "site")

# ── 1. Lollipop with clusters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
sensitivity_clustered %>%
  filter(scenario == "SSP5-8.5 2100") %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = GPP_pct_change, colour = cluster_multi)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = site, y = 0, yend = GPP_pct_change), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_colours) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% change in GPP", colour = "Cluster",
       title = "Projected GPP change under SSP5-8.5 2100") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")

# ── 2. Heatmap with cluster annotation ───────────────────────────────────────
sensitivity_clustered %>%
  filter(scenario != "Current") %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order),
         scenario = factor(scenario, levels = c("SSP2-4.5 2050",
                                                 "SSP5-8.5 2050",
                                                 "SSP5-8.5 2100"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = scenario, y = site, fill = GPP_pct_change)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(GPP_pct_change, 1)), size = 3) +
  # cluster label on right side
  geom_text(aes(x = 3.6, label = cluster_multi, colour = cluster_multi),
            size = 3, hjust = 0) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#c0392b", mid = "white", high = "#4682B4",
                       midpoint = 0, name = "% change\nin GPP") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_colours, guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Projected % change in GPP across scenarios and sites") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      plot.margin = unit(c(5, 60, 5, 5), "pt"))

# ── Fix 1: margin error — use unit = "pt" ────────────────────────────────────
# Replace margin(5, 60, 5, 5, "pt") with:
plot.margin = margin(5, 60, 5, 5, unit = "pt")

# ── Fix 2: label warning in geom_smooth — move label out of global aes ────────
sensitivity_clustered %>%
  filter(scenario == "SSP5-8.5 2100") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vpd_slope, y = GPP_pct_change, colour = cluster_multi)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = site), vjust = -0.8, size = 3) +   # label only in geom_text
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_colours) +
  labs(x = "GPP ~ VPD slope (baseline sensitivity)",
       y = "% change in GPP (SSP5-8.5 2100)",
       colour = "Cluster",
       title = "Sites with stronger VPD sensitivity are more vulnerable") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
